meta.source: KiCad 10.0.6 stroke font (newstroke, CC0 1.0), read with pcbnew by gen/art.py --extract-font
meta.note: glyph segments [x0, y0, x1, y1] for a 1 mm text of thickness 0, left-justified and vertically centred (KiCad's default): x from the pen, y from the anchor.  A thickness th moves the glyphs by x_th*th (left and right justification) and y_th*th; sub- and superscripts are scale times as big and dy (times the height) lower
